[FACT] User has started attending Buddhist meditation sessions at the Dhamma Center on Tuesdays and Thursdays.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for guidance on mindfulness exercises to supplement their meditation practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended apps for guided meditations:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Headspace: Popular app with guided meditations for stress, anxiety, sleep, and focus. (Free trial, then subscription-based)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Calm: Offers guided meditations, sleep stories, and relaxing music. (Free trial, then subscription-based)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Insight Timer: Free app with a vast library of guided meditations and a timer for personal practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Buddhify: Offers guided meditations for different parts of the day. (One-time purchase)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. 10% Happier: Focuses on mindfulness and stress reduction. (Free trial, then subscription-based)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended websites for guided meditations:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Dhamma.org: Official website of the Dhamma Centers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. UCLA Mindful Awareness Research Center: Offers free guided meditations and resources.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Mindful.org: Provides guided meditations, articles, and courses on mindfulness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. BuddhaNet: Comprehensive website with guided meditations and teachings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested other resources:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. YouTube Channels: Guided Meditation, Meditation Oasis, The Mindful Movement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Podcasts: The Mindful Kind, Mindfulness for Beginners, The Daily Meditation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Books: "Mindfulness in Plain English" by Bhante Henepola Gunaratana, "Wherever You Go, There You Are" by Jon Kabat-Zinn.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to start small with 5-10 minute meditations and gradually increase practice.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on incorporating mindfulness into daily routines.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested practical advice for incorporating mindfulness into daily activities:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eating: Savor food, eliminate distractions, notice hunger and fullness, chew thoroughly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Walking: Pay attention to feet, bring awareness to breath, notice
